title: Quantitative Trader Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Quantitative Trader.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Market Microstructure & Order Dynamics: Bid-ask spread dynamics, market making heuristics, adverse selection, order book depth, and liquidity provisioning.
2. Risk Management & PnL Discipline: Real-time risk exposure monitoring, Greeks management (options/derivatives), position sizing, and stop-loss execution.
3. Quantitative Intuition & Mental Probability: Expected value calculation under time pressure, Bayesian probability updates, and game theory.
4. Execution Strategy: Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP), Time Weighted Average Price (TWAP), implementation shortfall, and exchange fee optimization.
